interpretation.candidate_set_reconciliation: The census report identity set exactly equals independent raw enumeration by slot, signature, and instruction path; every transaction was normalized and every raw matching instruction was reconciled.
interpretation.captured_class_denominator: All matching exact 25-byte valid-boolean buy_exact_quote_in references with 23 fixed IDL accounts and three trailing accounts independently enumerated in the 16 hash-bound captured full blocks.
interpretation.structural_result: The frozen SDK pool-v2 prefix predicate passes 190 rows; two failed-transaction attempts fail message-privilege checks and remain quarantined.

limitations: A matching pool-v2 PDA prefix is only an SDK-source-bound structural candidate; it does not prove initialized historical pool state or which builder produced the transaction.
Successful transaction references are not independently reconciled economic fills or settled wallet outcomes.
Failed transactions remain attempt-only, even when all structural account checks pass.
Cashback applicability, fees moved, reserves, price, Token-2022 effects, CPI sibling effects, and training/execution admission are not assessed.
This classifier is restricted to exact 25-byte valid-boolean buy_exact_quote_in with exactly three remaining accounts; all other shapes remain quarantined.
